combo_label: School Days × Magic & Illusion × The Wild West

entries.clue: Something your eyes swear to that never actually happened
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Stiff shoulder bag that thumped your hip on the walk to lessons
Lesson space of paired tables, a big board and a wall of artwork
Rise slowly into the air with nothing at all holding you up
Spread of grazing land where cattle are raised and rounded up
Ordeal in a silent hall where papers are turned over at a signal
Tall black headgear that somehow holds a whole rabbit
Pavement game of numbered squares, a pebble and one-legged jumps
Made-up story passed off as fact, like the Loch Ness photo
Band of armed townsfolk riding out together to run down a gang
